title: Leaving Singapore
summary: A practical exit sequence — tax clearance, housing deposits, shipping, and pass cancellation — so the last month is orderly rather than chaotic.

sections.title: Work backwards from your flight
sections.body: Most exits need 6–10 weeks of lead time. Start with IRAS tax clearance and shipping slots; everything else fits around those two constraints.
bullets: Confirm last working day and any garden leave with HR
Book international movers early for peak June/July and December windows
Align lease break / diplomatic clause notice with your departure date

sections.title: IRAS tax clearance (Form IR21)
sections.body: Employers generally must file Form IR21 and withhold monies until IRAS issues tax clearance for a leaving employee. Do not assume your final salary is free to spend until clearance is done.
bullets: Ask HR when IR21 will be filed and what documents they need from you
Keep payslips, stock awards, and director fees documentation handy
Expect processing time — clearance is not same-day

sections.title: Cancel passes and dependants
sections.body: Employment Pass / S Pass cancellation is usually employer-led. Dependant and LTVP statuses are tied to the main pass — sequence cancellations carefully if family members leave on different dates.
bullets: Confirm who submits the cancellation (HR vs you)
Check short-term visit privileges after cancellation if you need a buffer week
Update Singpass and bank KYC after your FIN status changes

sections.title: Lease exit and deposit recovery
sections.body: Inventory check-out, utility final readings, and aircon servicing clauses decide how much of your deposit returns. Photograph everything on move-out day.
bullets: Serve notice per tenancy agreement (diplomatic clause if applicable)
Schedule landlord / agent check-out with daylight photos
Close SP Group and broadband accounts; keep final bills

sections.title: Shipping out, storage, and pets
sections.body: Sea freight is cheaper but slow; air freight suits essentials. Pet export needs NParks / AVS paperwork and airline pet policies — start weeks ahead.
bullets: Get two mover quotes with door-to-door vs port-to-port clarity
Separate “first week abroad” suitcase from deep storage
For pets: microchip, rabies titres, and crate training timelines

sections.title: Banks, insurance, and subscriptions
sections.body: Close or dormant local accounts deliberately. Keep one account briefly if deposits or tax refunds are still inbound — then close it.
bullets: Update address on insurance and investment platforms
Cancel telco, gym, club, and streaming local billing
Export CPF statements if you ever contributed; EP holders often have none

sections.title: Schools and records (families)
sections.body: Request transcripts and recommendation letters before the last week of term. International schools often need written withdrawal notice.
bullets: Confirm notice periods and fee refund policies
Collect vaccination and learning-support records
Ask for digital copies as well as sealed transcripts

sections.title: Say goodbye on purpose
sections.body: The logistics will consume you. Put one dinner, one hawker farewell, and one photo walk on the calendar so Singapore does not end as only admin.
bullets: Share a forwarding email with close contacts
Leave apartment Wi-Fi and spare keys labelled for the agent
Keep this playbook’s last-reviewed date in mind — rules change
